Independent left firing11 and held-grenade10 differ from right firing10/held-grenade9; selected maps inspected per pose. Same adult ACID bandana/brown hair/full beard, ivory knees, tan pouches and suppressed SOCOM. LEFT source page remains exact original independently authored native bytes, not a reflected or recoloured page. Old missing-plate right source and prior tests remain preserved. Exact unchanged LEFT previous native bytes kept. LEFT hit now9, reload12; shooting recovery now guard1 on both faces rather than a hit/reload label. Existing RIGHT native page remains byte-identical. All original left/right sources and dormant erroneous LEFT12 labeling are preserved in earlier versions; actual utility remains the original recover, not ammunition reload.; original independently authored CQC gala adaptation, not a released canonical costume.
